source_metadata.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
source_metadata.drive_filename: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research Early evidence from two case studies - 2607.27191v2.pdf

extraction.assertion_origin_policy: Reported/normalized claims preserved; no calculated effect sizes were added.

extraction_limitations: The extraction emphasizes independently reviewable study design, primary outcomes, resource-use findings, failure-mode findings, safety observations, limitations, and the principal appendix evidence.

Appendix B contains long-form expert reviews; their criterion scores and load-bearing critiques are represented, but every sentence of reviewer commentary was not atomized separately when it duplicated a main-text finding.
Appendix D summarizes external prior work; it is represented only as the paper authors secondary synthesis, not as primary-study evidence from the cited works.
Atoms are model-extracted and structurally/sufficiency validated but remain marked needs_review rather than human-verified.

whole_source_qa.cross_batch_consistency_review: Completed; related findings were retained separately when they referred to different runs, metrics, timepoints, or contexts. No unsupported conflict resolution was applied.
